outcome: Timely initiation of breastfeeding (within 1 hour of birth)
cohort: 407 mothers of children aged less than 24 months in Amibara district of Northeast Ethiopia
finding: Early initiation of breastfeeding within one hour of birth was found to be associated with urban residence and maternal education, while cesarean delivery and higher parity were negatively associated.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with decreased odds of timely initiation of breastfeeding.
